subject: Continuation of RoDTEP Scheme till December 31st 2026
clean_text:
[To be published in the Gazette of India Extraordinary Part II, Section-3, Sub-section (ii)]
Government of India
Ministry of Commerce & Industry
Department of Commerce
Directorate General of Foreign Trade
Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi
Notification No: 41/2026-27
Dated: 30th September 2026
Subject: Continuation of RoDTEP Scheme till December 31st, 2026 - reg.
S.O.(E): In exercise of the powers conferred under Section 5 of the Foreign Trade
(Development and Regulation) Act, 1992, as amended, read with Paragraph 1.02 of the Foreign
Trade Policy (FTP) 2023, as amended from time to time, the Central Government hereby notifies
that the Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products (RoDTEP) Scheme shall continue
up to 31st December 2026 and shall be available for exports made by Domestic Tariff Area
(DTA) units, Advance Authorisation (AA) holders, Special Economic Zone (SEZ) units and
Export Oriented Units (EOUs).
2.
The existing RoDTEP rates and value caps, as notified in Appendix 4R and Appendix
4RE, as applicable on September 30, 2026, shall continue unchanged during the aforesaid period.
3.
The other terms and conditions governing the Scheme shall remain unchanged.
Effect of this Notification: The RoDTEP Scheme is extended and shall apply to eligible exports
from DTA, AA, SEZ, and EOU units up to 31st December 2026.
This is issued with the approval of the Competent Authority.
(Lav Agarwal)
Director General of Foreign Trade &
Ex-officio Additional Secretary to the Government of India

subject: De minimis exemption from Registration-cum-Membership Certificate (RCMC) requirements for low-value exports - regarding
clean_text:
To be published in the Gazette of India Extraordinary Part-II, Section-3, Sub-Section (ii)

Government of India
Ministry of Commerce & Industry
Department of Commerce
Directorate General of Foreign Trade
Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi

Notification No. 36/2026-27
New Delhi, Dated: 15th September 2026

Subject: De minimis exemption from Registration-cum-Membership Certificate (RCMC)
requirements for low-value exports - regarding

S.O. (E): In exercise of powers conferred by Section 5 of Foreign Trade (Development &
Regulation) Act, 1992, read with paragraph 1.02 of the Foreign Trade Policy, 2023, as
amended from time to time, the Central Government hereby makes the following amendment
to the Foreign Trade Policy, 2023, with immediate effect:

In the Foreign Trade Policy, 2023, in paragraph 2.57, after sub-paragraph (b), the following
sub-paragraph shall be inserted, namely :—

(c) Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) above, the requirement
of a Registration-cum-Membership Certificate or a Certificate of Registration shall not apply to
an export consignment where the Free-on-Board(FOB) value of the consignment does not
exceed ₹ 3,00,000.

Effect of the Notification: With an objective to promote small value exports, especially
Exports through Postal, Courier and other emerging channels, this notification exempts export
consignments with an FOB value not exceeding ₹ 3,00,000 from the requirement of obtaining
a RCMC or Certificate of Registration. Export consignments with an FOB value exceeding ₹
3,00,000 shall continue to require a valid RCMC or Certificate of Registration wherever such
requirement is otherwise applicable under the Foreign Trade Policy, 2023.

This is issued with the approval of Minister of Commerce & Industry.

(Lav Agarwal)
Director General of Foreign Trade
& Ex-officio Addl. Secretary to Govt. of India
